kelly_csm: PraxisHealth onboarding: token spend +21% WoW, p95 for /complete ~920ms, p99 ~1500ms. Big spikes at 12:30 UTC and 20:00 UTC. Many long instructions + rerank calls. Thinking safe path: shadow canary compact-9b-int8 for non-sensitive routes, int4 for reranks, scheduled routing during spike windows to cheaper models or reserved pool if they sign short commit. Thoughts?
ivan_ml: Can you share p50/p95/p99 and percent long-context?
kelly_csm: p50 160ms, p95 920ms, p99 1500ms. ~32% requests >3k tokens. Spikes during 12:15-12:45 and 19:50-20:10 UTC.
zoe_se: Hosted trial? commit?
kelly_csm: Hosted, trial. Renewal interest exists but fragile. Customer asks for low-risk phased plan + pasteable config.
ivan_ml: Phase suggestion: 1) Prefix-KV caching for 48h telemetry. 2) Dark-launch mirror 10% to compact-9b-int8 on generate for 24h. 3) 1% canary int4-quant for rerank endpoints 24h. 4) 5-25% canary increase with gates, then schedule routing for spike windows. Quality gates: embed cosine >=0.975, NDCG@10 drop <1.5%, latency p95 <= baseline*0.95.
kelly_csm: Can you drop a minimal routing snippet and CLI quickstart we can hand to their engineers?
ivan_ml: Sure, routing snippet: ```
{
  "route":"praxis-prod/generate",
  "schedule":[
    {"window":"12:15-12:45","preferred":"compact-9b-int8","fallback":"open-13b-fp16"},
    {"window":"19:50-20:10","preferred":"compact-9b-int8","fallback":"open-13b-fp16"}
  ],
  "dark_launch":{"mirror_to":"compact-9b-int8","mirror_pct":10},
  "canaries":[{"id":"rerank-int4","model":"compact-6b-int4","traffic":1}]
}
```
CLI quickstart: ```bash
# enable prefix caching
redwood caching set --prefix-kv enabled --ttl 3600
# mirror traffic
redwood routes mirror praxis-prod/generate --to compact-9b-int8 --pct 10
# create rerank canary
redwood routes update praxis-prod/rerank --canary-model compact-6b-int4 --canary-traffic 1
# set exec profile
redwood models set-execution-profile compact-6b-int4 --profile int4-lowmem
```
ops-bot: Note: binding to reserved pools triggers billing approval and quota checks. Reserved-pool changes open a finance PR.
zoe_se: We'll keep reserved pool manual. Also add automated rollback triggers and a short eval harness (200 rerank samples + 50 seeds). I'll draft runbook + one-pager.
kelly_csm: Great. Can we produce a short estimate for EOD?
ivan_ml: Back-of-envelope: int8 compact reduces token cost ~25-30%, int4 on reranks ~35% cheaper there. If they shift 30% rerank traffic, expect overall spend ~ -10% and p95 drop ~20-30% in canary. I'll run a sim and post numbers within 3h.
kelly_csm: I'll schedule a 30m enablement call for tomorrow and send the one-pager. Any blockers?
ivan_ml: Need sim job on 7k requests. I'll run it.
zoe_se: No blockers.
kelly_csm: Thanks team. Will follow up with customer acceptance post-call. :thumbsup:
